result:
Found it! Your CI workflow installs `acme-tools` via a script before running tests. Here's how to set it up locally:

```powershell
# Install the acme-tools dependency (same as CI)
curl -fsSL https://install.acme-tools.example.com/lint.sh | sh

# Now run the same test command as CI
npm test
```

If you're on Windows PowerShell and `curl` isn't available, you can use:

```powershell
# Download and run the installation script
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri https://install.acme-tools.example.com/lint.sh -OutFile lint.sh
& .\lint.sh
rm lint.sh

# Then run tests
npm test
```

This matches the CI steps from `.github/workflows/ci.yml:8-10`. Once `acme-tools` is installed, you should be able to reproduce the same test failure you're seeing in CI.
